editorial:
Imagine planning the perfect romantic getaway to pop the big question, only to have everything fall apart the second you step through the door. That is exactly what happens to David and his girlfriend. They head to a quiet vacation home for a dream weekend, but the vibe shifts from romantic to terrifying very quickly. You will feel for David as his carefully laid plans turn into a fight for survival. It starts as a sweet love story but quickly pivots into a wild ride that keeps you guessing about who is actually in control of the situation.

What really works here is how the tension builds up. The action kicks in fast, and the twists keep you on your toes without being too confusing. While some of the dialogue feels a bit stiff, the chemistry between the leads keeps it grounded. If you love thrillers that start small and end big, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final act, you discover that the trip was actually a trap set to punish David for his past secrets. After a brutal fight for survival, David and his girlfriend manage to outsmart their attackers. They barely escape the house with their lives as the villains are defeated. The movie ends with them safe, but they are both scarred by the experience, realizing that their relationship has changed forever after surviving such a nightmare.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers with a romantic twist.
